dimensions.assessment: Applies directly to oil and gas lessees and operators submitting exploration or development plans on the Outer Continental Shelf.
dimensions.evidence: rescinds a requirement for lessees and operators to submit an archaeological report with any oil and gas exploration or development plan

dimensions.assessment: Changes regulatory compliance burdens for energy companies by removing a mandatory reporting requirement and reverting to discretionary reviews.
dimensions.evidence: nullifies BOEM's final rule titled Protection of Marine Archaeological Resources

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal spending or revenue changes are stated or implied beyond potential minor administrative cost adjustments.
